title: SKELETON: workspace, manifests, lib.rs/main.rs/cmd/mod.rs, every todo!() stub incl. wire payload structs, pre-declared dev-deps, envelopes/pusht.base.toml + placeholder fixtures, CI, Makefile, pyproject, docs copies
summary: Runs alone first (~60 min). Writes the workspace (libm unconditional; detect/fuse depend on core with default-features=false; fuse dev-depends on runtime; all dev-deps pre-declared), every lib.rs/main.rs (main.rs deny(unsafe_code) + #[allow(unsafe_code)] mod alloc_count), cmd/mod.rs with CrashReceipt, build.rs (rerun-if-changed .git/HEAD), Makefile (nostd-check = --no-default-features), CI, pyproject.toml, .gitignore, Cargo.lock, and every STUB module with the frozen signatures incl. Default/is_empty impls, FuseState #[default] Idle, hand-written Tally::default, and all wire payload structs; writes envelopes/pusht.base.toml byte-for-byte and [] placeholder brake/tier1 fixtures so every include_str! resolves. Acceptance: build + clippy -D warnings + fmt + nostd-check green on stubs. Compile-level dependency of every other package; STUB files (core/detect/fuse/canon/receipt/calib/runtime modules, cmd/*.rs, render.rs, alloc_count.rs, bench/run_all.sh, scripts/ci_python.sh, pusht.base.toml, two placeholder cases.json) are handed over to their owners.

title: Core types, envelope, TOML, compile(), brake feasibility
summary: Core frozen types (fmath, chunk IR, envelope TOML/validate/compile incl. embodiment_digest, provides_vel, horizon_ticks, n<=63, scores, verdict, state with Default, reason glossary, ack) and brake feasibility (exact PD rollout from row idx, v0 = simulator velocity; closed-form kinds) with a Python-generated fixture; owns envelopes/pusht.base.toml after WP-0 writes it.

title: Detectors: Tier-0 limits + projection, windowing, Tier-1 features, conformal runtime
summary: Detectors: Tier-0 limits + direction-preserving projection, K-of-N window + Trail (is_empty/Default), Tier-1 features (manifest-only speed_peak/stall; features() is the SOLE writer of rt.prev, raw-vs-raw TCE; overlap from t_emit differences), conformal standardise/aggregate/trip; numpy-generated fixtures to 1e-12.

title: The fuse: decide(), state machine, FuseRt, Tally
summary: The fuse: decide() with the nine ordered stages incl. GUARD time/chunk-seq continuity and brake_feasible(from=idx), never writing t1.prev; fsm::next over the 24-row table (17b for clamp_mode=Off); FuseRt (+Default, last_t, next_chunk_seq) and Tally (hand-written Default with NEG_INFINITY max_s/max_z); observe pass-through and decide-order tests.

title: Canonical encoding (JCS float-free), receipts, chains, ledger, handoff/ack, signing, history, keys, and the stdlib Python verifier
summary: JCS float-free canon (F64Hex/F64Array/floatify), tick + timing chains, ReceiptBody/VerdictCounts/evaluate_fuse(ephemeral_key), sign/verify (pubkey_ok, envelope_digest_ok, counts_ok, TEST_PUBKEYS), ledger, HandoffRecord (run/arm/episode bound; no state_digest) + ack verify with persisted nonces, curve sign/verify with DeltaCi metrics, history, keys (default dir $LICTOR_KEYS/$HOME/.lictor; refuses DrvFs and overwrite), the stdlib Python verifier with --pubkey and key-regex assert, fixtures incl. re-chain and re-sign tampers, docs/receipt-schema.md.

title: Offline calibration, envelope fit, metrics, Layer-A sweep, Layer-B curve (+ their CLI commands)
summary: Offline lane: CalibrationFile (n_total/n_scale/n_calib/split/embodiment_digest; SeedPool, Tier0Percentiles), load_traces via runtime TraceReader, split-CP calibrate (2-way approximate / --split 3 exact; horizon_ticks and pool checks), envelope fit (--operator oracle envelope; embodiment untouched), metrics (CP, McNemar, bootstrap, PoNR, ROC, AUCPDT), sweep (reuses calibration artefacts, tau_source), curve from receipts only (refusals: broken ledger, mixed/ephemeral keys, tier1/alpha vs run.json, index-set/declared-pool mismatch unless --partial, n<100 unless --allow-small; both deltas with CIs; tce_valid_frac; cross-run mismatches) + calibrate/sweep/curve/envelope CLIs and docs/calibration.md with n=137/59/45 worked numbers.

title: Runtime: wire schema + codec, Session, episode writer, latency histogram, trace files, `lictor serve`, Python client
summary: Runtime: wire payload structs with deny_unknown_fields everywhere, codec, Staging (the one wire->TickInput conversion), Session (embodiment/policy digest refusals, note_io_ns, episode_end accepted while faulted, nonces across episodes, inputs lictor:* keys, latency_label), episode writer + write_crash_episode, Hist, trace files, lictor serve and lictor crash-receipt, the Python client (LictorFault kills the child; null->inf mapping; allow_nan=False; hello asserts tier1/alpha; chunk_msg), docs/wire-protocol.md.

title: CLI: verify, replay, selftest, ledger, key, ack, history, version, render
summary: CLI rest: verify (pubkey/envelope/counts lines, HEAD MISMATCH, ticks header cross-check, --calibration, test-key WARNING), replay, selftest ([skip] on empty placeholder fixtures; four tampers), ledger, key init/pub (--force, --i-know, custody line), ack, history, version, render (control characters stripped).

title: PushT harness: lerobot compat + migration, policy with the n_action_steps=15 override, executor with delay injection, arms, resumable paired-seed runner, fault injection, replay policy, microbench
summary: PushT harness: compat (import lerobot.policies first; migrated checkpoint path; migration script named; bindings from importlib.metadata; inputs manifest), pusht_rollout (offline predict_action_chunk path with the six h15 asserts; vel_agent; coverage at t=0; wire labelling per exec mode; episode_end after fatal; fuse_crash handling), executor, inject, policy_replay, arms (tier1/alpha declared; oracle envelope), run.py (--plan --budget-min refusals, 1-vs-2 worker probe, crash-receipt + respawn, cross-run compare), microbench (day-0 gate), seeds (hash64 mod 2^64 with vectors), requirements (opencv-python-headless pinned). First deliverable: measured s/episode at B=1 and the h15 result.

title: Analysis, statistics, figures, experiment write-up, reproduction guide
summary: Analysis/figures/docs: stats.py cross-checks, analyze.py consuming summary.csv deltas verbatim, figures F1-F9 (hollow pilot points, tce_valid_frac bar, WSL2 latency_label captions, t_fail=0 artefact), docs/EXPERIMENT.md and docs/REPRODUCE.md (220-episode pilot, WSL2 sentence on every timing table).

title: Bench vectors, alloc/determinism tests, `lictor bench`, demo, CI scripts, fixtures
summary: Bench vectors and CI: alloc_count.rs (gated always-installed counting allocator), lictor bench (size_of line, X placeholders), fuse tests alloc.rs/determinism.rs via runtime Staging, synthetic fixture generator, latency/determinism/tamper (re-chain, re-sign, --pubkey)/workspace-breach/brake/failure-prediction (--allow-small) vectors, run_all.sh, ci_python.sh, demo.sh.

summary: Roadmap adapter stubs, clearly labelled UNVERIFIED: LeRobot ProcessorStep wrapper and openpi websocket proxy skeleton, importable without lerobot/openpi, with unit tests and adapters/README.md.

summary: Integration last: full workspace green, selftest, bench vectors, CI python, 20-episode smoke through the real fuse, curve --allow-small, replay 40/40; replaces synthetic fixtures with real traces; commits fitted envelopes (pusht.toml, pusht.oracle.toml), the fit report, figures and memos; fills README numbers; hands over the pilot commands with --plan output.
